[comment by Andaros210 (none)]
Same error occurs regardless of which of the two versions is used. Hope this helps you narrow down the problem.

[comment by malte0811 (owner)]
The first crash is a known incompatibility with Radium that needs changes on Ra's end to fix, see https://github.com/malte0811/FerriteCore/issues/80#issuecomment-1184121400.

The second crash shouldn't happen with FC 5.0.1. Make sure to delete the old build when you update, Forge's code to handle multiple versions of the same mod is broken.

In the future please upload crashlogs to https://gist.github.com or similar, it's much easier to read the issue if the long logs are behind links.

their issues tracker, although I assume they already have that posted by
